disposition_reason: EDXRF trace-element contents of 30 raw sepiolite clay samples from three open quarries in Central Anatolia, Turkey, with all-sample statistics (Table 1) and per-quarry means and ranges (Table 2).

study.design: geochemical survey of 30 sepiolite samples collected randomly from three open quarries
study.origin: Polatli-Ankara, Beylikova-Eskisehir and Sivrihisar-Eskisehir sepiolite quarries, Central Anatolia, Turkey
study.market: raw mineral, not a retail product
lod: Hg detection limit 1.0 mg/kg; '<' values in Table 2 (Cd < 2.0, Sn < 3.0, Zr < 1.0 mg/kg) imply limits for other elements; no other LODs stated
